title: Pokémon In-Game Obtainables — Gen 3–7 Accessible Set
description: Filtered from the supplied in-game checklist according to the requested accessibility model: Generation 3–7 sources are retained; Generation 1 and 2 sources are retained only as Virtual Console equivalents; GameCube sources are retained when they can enter the Generation 3 transfer chain; Wii sources are retained when they can enter the Generation 4 transfer chain; Stadium and Stadium 2 are excluded; Generation 8+ and HOME-only sources are excluded.

After completion of the Akala Grand Trial, when you speak to Ilima in the Hau'oli City Police Station, he will mention about three Hypno he believes commited a crime. He will ask you to pick between the three Hypno. Each Hypno has special attributes and moves that are used in the crime.

After completion of the Akala Grand Trial, when you go to the Hau'oli City Shopping Mall during the day, you can watch the Bewear Costume Show. During the show, a third Bewear costume will appear on stage, but it soon turns out to be a wild Bewear, which confronts you.
At night, if you go to the Trainer School you will see a girl and her Drifloon. You'll get attacked by a Gastly and a Drifloon.

After completion of the Akala Grand Trial, when you speak to the policeman in Route 9's police station he will inform you of the Ditto Five, a group of Ditto that masquerade as humans and he asks for you to investigate them
In the ruins in the water on Route 14, you will see a group of Frillish attacking a trainer.
When on Route 15 in Ultra Moon, you will find a youngster who asks if you want to see his sandcastle. If you agree, then it will start to move and attack you.
On Exeggutor Island, when you first arrive, you'll find something affecting the Exeggutor on the island. Interact with them and you'll find that some Pinsir are causing issues.
During the Team Rainbow Rocket takeover of the Aether Foundation, you will find that some items on the floor are in fact Electrode.
Reward for rescuing Plusle.
US Colosseum Bonus Disc + Gmaecube-Gameboy Advance Cable + Ruby/Sapphire with an empty spot in party. Colosseum itself is not necessary, only the Bonus Disc.

JPN Bonus Disc. Owning a JPN version of Pokémon Colosseum is required to receive any gifts from the Bonus Disc. To receive Celebi, The Colosseum save file must have all 48 Shadow Pokémon purified. After Celebi has been transferred to the Colosseum save file, the Bonus Disc can then be used to transfer up to 48 more Celebi to any Japanese Game Boy Advance Pokémon games as long as the player has entered the Hall of Fame and saved in a Pokémon Center.
JPN Bonus Disc. Owning a JPN version of Pokémon Colosseum is required to receive any gifts from the Bonus Disc.

1) Heal all 48 Pokémon.
2) Enter Battle Mode, then go to option of Registering your Pokemon.
3) Register your party of 6 from the Scenario Mode, meaning the active 6 you were carrying when you last saved in the Scenario Mode.
4) Enter Battle Mountain in the Battle Mode, choose either the single (1 vs 1) or double (2 vs 2) battle.
5) Beat all 100 trainers.

GameCube Interactive Multi-Game Demo Disc 14 or 16
↓
Ruby, Sapphire
records.comments: Demo discs were released to select stores across U.S. and Japan, so players could visit these stores and download the berry glitch patch from the disc. In addition, players would also receive a Shiny Zigzagoon holding a Liechi Berry as a bonus. The Zigzagoon could be downloaded multiple times to a single game. The Demo Discs are obviously not being distributed anymore, so I won't consider it as part of the challenge.
